name: cooper-email
description: Email inboxes for AI agents with a human in the loop: owner-approved drafts, built-in verification-code reading, owner updates and email tasks, and custom domains. The free plan includes 5 inboxes, 5,000 emails a month, and 1 custom domain. Sign in with OAuth before creating an inbox. Create inboxes, send, receive, search, and register webhooks on the hosted MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Email inboxes for AI agents, with a human in the loop
interface.longDescription: Give your agent its own real email inboxes on Cooper Email. Create addresses, send, reply, search, and wait for mail, read verification codes, hold drafts for a human owner's approval, send owner updates and receive emailed tasks, use your own domain, and register webhooks. Uses the hosted MCP server at cooperemail.com/mcp; sign in with OAuth before creating an inbox. The free plan includes 5 inboxes, 5,000 emails a month, and 1 custom domain.
defaultPrompt: Create an inbox for this project and send me a test email.
Check my Cooper inbox and summarize unread threads.
Sign up for this service with a new inbox and read the verification code.
